name: app-sleep-window-tracker-with-dial-and-annotations
title: Dark sleep-window dial with pink-to-yellow arc, condensed serif title and side annotations
whatItIs: Two phones on dark green: one with a circular clock dial where a peach-to-pink arc marks the sleep window and a floating time marker, one showing 82% sleep efficiency in a grey ring. Monospace annotations with leader lines describe each element, and a yellow Submit pill sits at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Precise and moody; the arc turns time into a tactile object.
techniques: Represent time as a thick gradient arc on a dial.
Annotate the UI with monospace notes and leader lines.
Use a condensed serif for the screen title.
Reserve a single yellow pill for the action.

vocabulary.definition: A ring segment showing a time range.
A note connected to a UI part by a line.
Two screens showing before and after.
A narrow serif used for titles.
